title: Rhythms of Nature
summary: How plants, animals, farms and festivals change through the year, and how to keep a nature journal.

cbse.chapter: Our Wondrous World (2025) Ch 9: Rhythms of Nature

objectives: I can describe how plants and animals change with the seasons.
I can name India’s main seasons.
I can link farming and festivals to seasons.
misconceptions: Trees look the same all year.
Birds live in one place forever.
Seasons are the same all over India.
